components.name: Primary Button

components.html: Jetzt Partner werden
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #d9bd85; padding: 16px 28px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; color: #05060a; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #f3e7cd, #d9bd85); box-shadow: 0 10px 38px rgba(217,189,133,0.32), 0 0 60px rgba(217,189,133,0.16); transition: transform 0.25s ease-out, box-shadow 0.25s ease-out, filter 0.25s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 54px rgba(217,189,133,0.48), 0 0 90px rgba(217,189,133,0.26); filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9bd85; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(217,189,133,0.22); }

components.css: .ds-card-benefit { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(217,189,133,0.4); background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #171b2a, #05060a); padding: 30px 26px; box-shadow: 0 0 44px rgba(217,189,133,0.10); transition: transform 0.3s ease-out, box-shadow 0.3s ease-out, border-color 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-card-benefit:hover { transform: scale(1.03); border-color: #d9bd85; box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(217,189,133,0.30), 0 0 80px rgba(217,189,133,0.20); } .ds-card-benefit__watermark { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.5; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(217,189,133,0.07) 0 1px, transparent 1px 9px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(217,189,133,0.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 9px); } .ds-card-benefit__top { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-card-benefit__icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(217,189,133,0.4); background: rgba(217,189,133,0.1); color: #d9bd85; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(217,189,133,0.25); } .ds-card-benefit__label { font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(245,241,232,0.6); } .ds-card-benefit__stat { position: relative; font-weight: 500; font-size: 48px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin-top: 26px; color: #d9bd85; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(217,189,133,0.45), 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-card-benefit__text { position: relative; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(245,241,232,0.74); margin-top: 14px; }

components.name: Hero Portrait Frame
components.description: Gold-framed, glowing square portrait of Manjeet beside the hero headline — the page's personal, exclusive-feeling first moment.
components.css: .ds-hero-portrait { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(217,189,133,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(217,189,133,0.3), 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-hero-portrait img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-hero-portrait__sheen { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(200deg, transparent 45%, rgba(5,6,10,0.55) 100%), radial-gradient(120% 90% at 100% 0%, rgba(217,189,133,0.22), transparent 55%); }

components.name: Step Marker

components.css: .ds-step-marker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #05060a; font-weight: 500; font-size: 17px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border: 1px solid #d9bd85; color: #d9bd85; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(217,189,133,0.3); } .ds-step-marker--final { border-color: #2fa373; color: #79ddae; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(47,163,115,0.35); }

narrative.overview: Back to the vault, deliberately — and turned up. This is the third iteration of the system: it started dark and private, moved into daylight as an open ledger, and now returns to the dark private-banking world with more light inside it, not less. Every gold surface earns a glow now, not just on hover; a white-hot core sits inside several of those glows, so gold reads as catching real light rather than sitting flat. The hero now opens with Manjeet's own portrait in a glowing gold frame beside the headline — the exclusivity is personal, not abstract.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy base with a warm off-white ink for body text — unchanged since the system's first version.
Gold now carries a genuine second accent partner: crisp White, used sparingly inside glow cores and text-shadows for a catching-light effect.
Glow is no longer purely hover-triggered — cards, the CTA panel, the video frame, and the steps line all carry a persistent ambient glow at rest.
A large, gold-framed portrait of Manjeet anchors the hero next to the headline.
Same fluid clamp()-based type and spacing scale throughout all three iterations; only color and light intensity changed.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only decorative hue; emerald stays reserved for trust/security.

rules.name: The Catching-Light Rule
rules.body: Any gold text or glow gets a thin white-hot core layered underneath the wider gold glow. Gold alone reads flat; gold-plus-white-core reads like foil catching a real light source.

rules.name: The Illuminated-Vault Rule
rules.body: Glow is now ambient-plus-interactive, not interactive-only: every gold surface has some glow at rest, and gets brighter on hover/scroll/focus.

dos: Do pair every gold text/border/fill with a glow (ambient at rest, intensified on interaction).
Do use White strictly inside glow cores and text-shadows, never as a standalone fill, border, or body-text color.
Do keep emerald reserved for trust/security meaning only.
Do size any future hero/portrait imagery to at least the display resolution needed.
donts: Don't revert to hover-only glow; ambient-at-rest glow is now the baseline.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a third accent hue.
Don't stretch or off-center-crop the hero portrait — its aspect-square frame exists so the 1:1 source needs no cropping.
